text_block_list.name: Narration

い、

い、

text_block_list.name: Rurui

あの……

どうか

text_block_list.name: Violet

text_block_list.name: Rurui

text_block_list.name: Rurui
text_block_list.text:

with?

text_block_list.name: Rurui
text_block_list.text:

Please be carefulsh not to take the cloth

text_block_list.name: Rurui
text_block_list.text:
......This areash looks goodsh. Everyone'sh

text_block_list.orig_text:
…………

みなしゃんお揃いでしゅ。

text_block_list.name: Rurui
text_block_list.text:
Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh Wgahnagl

text_block_list.orig_text:

text_block_list.name: Rurui
text_block_list.text:
Today is the daysh of my report to

text_block_list.name: Rurui

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.orig_text:

text_block_list.name: Rurui
text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Rurui
text_block_list.text: U-Ujyuu!? You won't accept my requestsh...?

text_block_list.name: The 22nd Prince

text_block_list.name: Rurui
text_block_list.text:

う、

あ、
あのでしゅね！
こ、

text_block_list.name: The 22nd Prince

text_block_list.name: Rurui

はぁ……

text_block_list.name: Rurui

text_block_list.name: Rurui

text_block_list.name: Rurui

text_block_list.name: Rurui

text_block_list.name: Rurui
text_block_list.text:
Long before I hatchedsh from my egg, the

text_block_list.name: Rurui

text_block_list.name: Rurui

text_block_list.name: Rurui
text_block_list.text: Well... I'd be the 33rd, to be precisesh♪

text_block_list.name: Rurui
text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Rurui
text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: The 22nd Prince

か。

text_block_list.name: The 22nd Prince

text_block_list.name: Rurui

text_block_list.name: The 22nd Prince
text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Rurui
text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: The 22nd Prince

text_block_list.orig_text:

…………
だッ……

『声』の具現者！

text_block_list.name: Rurui

text_block_list.name: ルルィ
text_block_list.text:
……
あたちは、
おかちいんでちょうか……
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
あたちは、
おかちいんでちょうか……

text_block_list.name: Rurui

text_block_list.name: Rurui

ペコリーヌしゃま。
それに、
ライラエルしゃま、
ネフィ＝ネラしゃま。

text_block_list.name: Rurui
text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.orig_text:

text_block_list.name: Rurui
text_block_list.text: ...Ujyuruuu♪ Alrightsh! I'm doing thish!

text_block_list.name: Rurui

text_block_list.name: Rurui

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.orig_text:
